# Meetings

> Open-source meetings app for teams: schedule across time zones, call in the browser, keep a recap of every call. A fully working app at https://convex-meetings.stream, built with Convex, TanStack Start and Cloudflare RealtimeKit.

Only the landing page is public. Everything else needs a signed-in account. Sign-in is Google or GitHub followed by the person's passkey, so an agent acting for someone works inside that person's signed-in browser session. There is no public API.

Page state lives in the URL. An agent can open any page below in the exact state it needs by setting its query parameters, without clicking through the UI. Meetings are identified by a code like `abc-defg-hij`. Times are UTC milliseconds and time zones are IANA names. List parameters are JSON arrays, for example `zones=["Europe/Berlin","America/New_York"]`.

## Pages

- [Home](https://convex-meetings.stream/home): upcoming meetings for the active organization
- [Schedule a meeting](https://convex-meetings.stream/schedule): find a time and send invites. `start` (UTC ms) and `minutes` preselect a slot, `zone` sets the organizer's time zone, `zones` adds time zones to compare, `view=list` shows a list instead of the grid
- [Calendar](https://convex-meetings.stream/calendar): `event=<code>` opens one meeting with everyone's replies, `declined=true` shows meetings you declined, `zones` adds time zones, `new=true` opens Schedule a meeting over the calendar (`start`, `minutes`, `zone` and `view=list` work as on /schedule)
- [Meetings](https://convex-meetings.stream/meetings): upcoming meetings, `tab=past` for past ones
- `/meetings/<code>`: one meeting. `call=true` joins its call, `side=chat`, `side=participants` or `side=polls` opens a side panel
- `/meetings/<code>/recaps/<n>`: transcript and recording of the meeting's nth call, `q` searches the transcript
- [Inbox](https://convex-meetings.stream/inbox): notifications, such as meeting invites and replies
- [Members](https://convex-meetings.stream/members): people in the organization, `q` filters them
- [Settings](https://convex-meetings.stream/settings): `/settings/account`, `/settings/general` (theme, time zone, working hours), `/settings/meetings`, `/settings/org`

## Shared links

These carry secrets. Open them only when the person gave you the link, and never index or share them.

- `/m/<code>`: a meeting link from an email invite. Signed-in members go to the meeting, others can ask to join as a guest
- `/invite/<secret>`, `/join/<secret>`: join an organization
- `/guest/<secret>`: a guest's pass into one meeting

## Source

- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/saranatour1/convex-meetings): the full app, with `ARCHITECTURE.md` describing how it is built
- [Convex](https://convex.dev): the backend it is built with
